pandas is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2015.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1) and [Systems and infrastructure](@/projects/systems.md) (1).

Most recently: [docker-datasciencetoolbox](@/work/docker-datasciencetoolbox.md): Dockerized http://datasciencetoolbox.org; [apollo-box](@/work/apollo-box.md): All needed data science stuff in one box.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses pandas: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links pandas to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
